techStack: React 19 + TypeScript 5.7 with strict mode: noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters both enabled — dead exports like normalizeSearch will cause compile errors
Vitest 3 + React Testing Library 16 with jsdom — tests use userEvent and render integration, not unit mocks of filterProducts
Vite 6 with verbatimModuleSyntax:true — type-only imports must use 'import type'; value imports must not be mixed with type imports
ESLint react-hooks plugin enforces exhaustive deps on useMemo — dependency array must accurately reflect what the callback references
Build pipeline: tsc -b first, then vite build — TypeScript errors block the build before bundling
features: filterProducts(products: Product[], filters: FilterState): Product[] is fully implemented in productFilters.ts and is functionally correct — applies search (case-insensitive trim), category, inStockOnly, and sortBy in sequence
App.tsx's visibleProducts useMemo (lines 19-44) duplicates all of filterProducts() inline — the two implementations are behaviorally identical across all test paths
filterProducts is already imported in App.tsx but never called — it is dead import usage (the logic is inlined instead)
normalizeSearch (productFilters.ts lines 10-13) is exported but never imported or called anywhere in the codebase — pure dead code with a comment acknowledging it
FilterPanel.tsx and SortSelect.tsx are pure UI components with no filter/sort business logic — they must not be changed

6 integration test files cover: filtering (search/category/stock), sorting (3 modes), clear filters, pagination, render, and loading/error states — plus a hidden edge-cases file covering case-insensitivity, whitespace trimming, empty results, and category='All'
architecture: Layer structure: api/ → hooks/ → App.tsx → components/; utils/ contains pure functions consumed by App.tsx and hooks/
useProductFilters.ts owns filter state (FilterState) and data fetching — it returns raw products and filters separately; App.tsx is responsible for applying filterProducts()
Requirement 1 explicitly mandates the useMemo in App.tsx calls filterProducts — the correct call site is App.tsx, not useProductFilters.ts (contra architecture agent's suggestion)
FilterState type is exported from productFilters.ts and imported by FilterPanel.tsx, SortSelect.tsx, and useProductFilters.ts — must remain stable
Files requiring changes: App.tsx (replace inline useMemo body), productFilters.ts (remove normalizeSearch)
Files that must not change: all components, hooks/useProductFilters.ts, api/, types/, utils/formatters.ts, tests/
edgeCases: Inline logic in App.tsx and filterProducts() are functionally identical — trim/lowercase for search, strict equality for category/stock, spread-before-sort for immutability — no behavioral regression when swapping
whitespace-only search (e.g. '   ') must still be treated as empty — filterProducts uses filters.search.trim() !== '' guard, which handles this correctly; covered by hidden edge-cases test

useMemo wrapper must be preserved with the same [products, filters] dependency array — it is a React performance primitive, not business logic; removing or mis-specifying deps would break render tests

filterProducts import in App.tsx must remain after the refactor — it becomes the active call; removing it would cause a TypeScript compile error (noUnusedLocals would also flag it if the call were removed)
normalizeSearch has no type exports or imports in any file — removing it causes zero TypeScript fallout beyond its own declaration
category 'All' must show all products — filterProducts skips category filter when filters.category === 'All'; this path is tested in hidden edge-cases suite
Sort 'default' must return original fetch order — filterProducts returns the filtered array unsorted when sortBy === 'default'; covered by initial render test
